title: No pumpkin blur
description: No more pumpkin blur, making end exploration easier
body:
# 🎃 No Pumpkin Blur

A simple Minecraft resource pack that removes the pumpkin blur overlay when wearing a carved pumpkin.

## ✨ Features
- Removes the annoying pumpkin overlay
- Clean fullscreen view while wearing pumpkins
- Works in survival and multiplayer
- Lightweight and performance friendly

## 📦 Installation

### Minecraft Java Edition
1. Download the resource pack `.zip`
2. Open Minecraft
3. Go to **Options → Resource Packs**
4. Click **Open Pack Folder**
5. Move the pack into the folder
6. Enable the pack in-game

## 🛠️ Compatibility
- Minecraft Java Edition
- Works on latest versions (26.1+)

## 📸 What It Does
Normally, wearing a carved pumpkin adds a dark blur around your screen.  
This pack removes that overlay completely while keeping the pumpkin wearable.
